title: Help & safety
intro: If you are in danger, use these numbers now. DETOXYA does not replace emergency services.
inCrisisCta: I am in crisis right now
harm1: Never use alone: tell someone or use a supervised-use service.
harm2: Do not mix opioids with alcohol or benzodiazepines: the combination can stop your breathing.
harm3: Keep naloxone at hand if you use opioids and teach someone close how to use it.
harm4: After a period without using, your tolerance drops: a previous dose can be lethal.
harm5: If you use, try a smaller amount than usual, especially after a break.
notAloneBody: Thousands of people are going through what you are going through. Asking for help — from a line, a doctor, a friend — is an act of courage, not weakness.
medicalNote: If you drink alcohol or take benzodiazepines daily, only stop under medical supervision: abrupt withdrawal can cause seizures.
